Your selected model provider receives the messages and screen content needed for a task. Websites, connected apps and services have their own data practices. Review the content before sharing it, and keep passwords and verification codes out of conversations.
Open Apporo aiot and summarize the visible status of the meeting room. Do not change any devices.
Open Apporo platform and summarize the tasks assigned to me, highlighting overdue items. Do not edit any records.
Open Apporo smart and show the available computer sessions. Ask me which session to use before sending a task.
Compare three air quality monitors for a meeting room. Include sources, prices and what still needs checking.
Remind me in 30 minutes to review the maintenance checklist.
Find the AI apps installed on my phone and explain what each can help me do.

https://gateway.example.com

Use the CLI from this Apporo Assistant source checkout (tools/mika/scripts/mika_cli.py). Set MIKA_ANDROID_PACKAGE=com.apporo.assistant before connecting over authorized USB ADB. For Wi-Fi or a private VPN, use the address shown on the phone and a private token file. Run connect or doctor to verify connectivity. Do not submit tasks or print tokens. See docs-apporo/agent-quickstart.en.md in the source checkout.

Add a Streamable HTTP MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:%1$d/mcp. Use the connection token from Apporo Assistant as a Bearer Authorization header, stored privately. Never print it in the conversation. Refresh the tools and check the request time on the phone. See docs-apporo/mcp.en.md in the source checkout.
